<function name="SetRenderAngles" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the render angles override for the entity. <page>Entity:GetAngles</page> will return the value set by this function until the override is disabled. (This is all this does internally)

See <page>Entity:SetRenderOrigin</page> for the function to manipulate origin.

Not to be confused with <page>Player:SetRenderAngles</page>.
</description>

</function>
